description: Get the single most recent event captured by a bucket, optionally filtered by provider and event type. Returns one event with its headers, body and delivery results — the one-shot answer to "what did Stripe last send me". 404 if nothing matches, so you never index into an empty list.

provider.description: Filter to a provider attributed at ingest (e.g. stripe, github).

type.description: The provider's own event name, matched exactly (e.g. payment_intent.succeeded).

name: latest_event
